technical.summary: Mixed signals with bullish candlestick pattern and volume confirmation offset by weak momentum, bearish MACD, price below key moving averages, and lack of trend strength—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows weak fundamental signals with no insider/institutional activity, zero government contracts, no lobbying data, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 1 day presents elevated volatility risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 purchase vs 1 sale, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (381.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings binary event create severe risk environment for ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers candlestick pattern with bullish OBV and supertrend, combined with extreme fear sentiment (14/100) and contrarian buy signal, offer technical setup and sentiment opportunity near support at 261.984.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary within 24 hours, VIX crisis regime (381.4), price below all key moving averages (EMA-21, SMA-21, 200-EMA), weak momentum (MACD negative, RSI sub-50, ADX 17), and unfavorable macro environment create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While three white soldiers pattern and extreme fear sentiment (14/100) offer contrarian appeal at support, the critical earnings binary within 24 hours combined with VIX crisis regime (381.4) and price below all key moving averages creates unacceptable risk-reward asymmetry for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 1 day will trigger binary volatility spike; existing position in ACN and 3 other IT holdings create sector concentration risk that amplifies downside exposure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ACN position plus 3 other IT names in 23-position portfolio; earnings proximity and sector concentration argue against adding exposure.
